name: X-37B OTV-2 (USA-226)
first: USA-226 — 469 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
description: Second X-37B flight, second of two flight vehicles. Launched 2011-03-05 22:46 UTC from CCAFS SLC-41 on Atlas V 501 AV-026; landed at Vandenberg AFB 2012-06-16 12:48 UTC. 469 days on orbit — at the time the longest US autonomous orbital spaceflight, surpassed by every subsequent OTV flight. Payloads classified.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Autonomous runway landing at Vandenberg AFB 2012-06-16.
